placements.title: From knowledge retention to commanded erasure
placements.frame: What authority and rationale drive the directive suppression of specific decisions and knowledge from the organizational record?
placements.why: Both segments are imperative commands — one to forget a named decision, one to remove all knowledge of a named migration — performed in the same flat authority-ranking register. This is a thematic subject about deliberate, authority-driven suppression of organizational knowledge that future envelopes could continue to feed, not a one-time fact. The grain test admits it: the theme of commanded forgetting is true beyond the specific decision and migration named here.
